name: InnerVerse
summary:
InnerVerse is a place to slow down.

Put on your headset, press Start, and let a calm, living sky wrap all around you. Soft stereoscopic 360° visuals drift slowly across the whole sphere: glowing rings, gentle auroras and flowing ribbons of light, while relaxing music plays in the background. There is nothing to win, nothing to manage and nothing to learn. You simply sit back, breathe and watch.

Made for relaxation

• Dozens of slow-moving 360° stereoscopic skies, made to calm rather than excite

• Shuffle
